statement.text:
Kropholler’s hierarchy (see 15.45) is closed under finite extensions, that is,
(Hα F)F ⊆ Hα F for every α (P. Kropholler, J. Pure Appl. Algebra, 90 (1993), 55–67).
Let a hierarchy of tdlc groups HK be defined analogously to Kropholler’s hierarchy
in 15.45, with K being the class of profinite groups and with the cell stabilisers of the
admissible action required to be open.
    Is it true that HK is closed under profinite extensions, that is, (Hα K)K ⊆ Hα K
for every α?                                                                 G. C. Cook
